text:
Maria Chen: morning — quick sales standup: pipeline + blockers

Leo Patel: NimbusHealth — negotiating SOW, legal asked for pen-test & SOC2, customer also wants IP allowlist + private VPC. expecting signature next week. :thumbsup:

Anjali Rao: demo env ready for NimbusHealth, but they'll need an IP allowlist and a short-term staging token. Can engineering provide a static egress IP or guidance? Also they asked about audit logs retention.

Ethan Kim: we can share SOC2 report and recent pentest summary. For IP allowlist, we don't expose a single egress IP for hosted right now — options: dedicated capacity or VPC private deployment. I'll ping infra. :eyes:

Olga Sokolova: If they need audit log retention policy we can provide 90/365-day exports. Is that sufficient?

Maria Chen: customer asked 1yr retention — can we offer export for long-term? Need quick answer for contracting.

Tarun Singh: For dedicated capacity, we can reserve a pool and offer fixed egress. Need approval from infra for patch window. I'll open an internal ticket.

Anjali Rao: adding contract asks: encryption in transit + at rest confirmed. They also want data residency in eu-west. Any blockers?

Ethan Kim: EU residency possible via our private deploy options. For hosted, we have eu region but not guaranteed data residency for S3 backups unless private deployment. I'll attach checklist.

security-bot: Automated Note: SOC2 report uploaded to /shared/security/customer-assets/NimbusHealth/2026-02. PEN-REPORT-2025.pdf

Maria Chen: thanks. Can someone post the ticket IDs we create here so I can paste into the SOW?

Tarun Singh: created INF-4823 for dedicated capacity request. Assigning to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4823

Ethan Kim: created SEC-317 for compliance docs request. I'll attach a short CSV with allowed fields. 

Anjali Rao: demo checklist: 1) staging token 2) IP allowlist 3) audit log export 4) SSO enable. Who owns SSO config?

Olga Sokolova: I'll take SSO config. Need their IdP metadata. Maria, can you request?

Maria Chen: on it — asking for metadata now. Also pushing for a signature by Friday; will update here.

Leo Patel: small blocker: need a stable model version for pricing estimate. Product, can you confirm recommended model and quantization profile for NimbusHealth? 

Olga Sokolova: recommend rdx-medium-quantized for PHI redaction flows; cost estimate posted shortly.

Anjali Rao: adding note — for demo please use staging key `stg_nimbus_demo` (expires in 7 days). Do not share in customer email.

Ethan Kim: security note: for demo sso/testing, use ephemeral accounts and rotate keys. :lock:

Maria Chen: perfect. I'll collate answers and update SOW draft. If anything else, ping here. :white_check_mark:
